name: The Adventure Games
author: Kurtg1234
description: Welcome to my first game ever made. The reason I'm making this game is because it's a project for school. It's a game where you have to "parkour" to get to the finish. You get point for every fruit you collect and you get point for killing enemy's. Now my game isn't long at all but I will try to change that. For controls you can use arrows, wasd. I hope you all like it and if there is a problem or you have an idee to make it better/more fun, you can put it in the comments. (This game is not intented for commercial purposes, this is just a schoolproject)
